{{Quote|Mar Balayan was believed killed nearly five years ago, prior to the debacle at Hoth, as all signs of him and his activities abruptly vanished after he was reported fighting a group of Stalimur pirates.|[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]''|<ref name="Journal10">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>}}
'''Stalimur''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. The stormy world featured moors inhabited by a population of [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] known as the [[Stalimuran]]s, who observed a [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Winter/Legends|winter]] holiday known as [[The Devouring (holiday)|the Devouring]]. The world was also [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the vicious [[Stalimur pirates]].

==Description==
Stalimur was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Xim" /> located in the [[Stalimur system/Legends|Stalimur system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a part of the [[Back Spiral]] area of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], which was situated in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]<ref name="Xim" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> Stalimur lay between the [[Brigia system/Legends|Brigia]] and [[Erediss system]]s on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Tion Trade Route]]. It was a stormy world of windswept moors, the seasons of which included [[Winter/Legends|winter]].<ref name="Xim" />

==Inhabitants==
[[File:TheDevouring-TheHistoryOfXimAndTheTionCluster.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The inhabitants of Stalimur observed a holiday commemorating the Devouring (represented by the green arrow).]]
Stalimur was inhabited by the [[Stalimuran]]s, a population of [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] who had a dour and surly disposition well known beyond their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Equally notorious were the world's<ref name="Xim" /> groups<ref name="Journal10" /> of vicious [[Stalimur pirates|pirates]], who preyed on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in the Stalimur [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]].<ref name="Xim" /> The [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Mar Balayan]] was reported fighting one group of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]<ref name="Journal10" /> at some point between [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="Dates">{{JournalCite|1|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}} establishes that the "[[Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)|Wanted by Cracken]]" segment of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' represents an [[in-universe]] update to the [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'', the original version of which is presented in the sourcebook [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]. The latter work is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], and since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. Since {{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}} establishes that [[Mar Balayan]] fought the [[Stalimur pirates]] at some point nearly five years prior and before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]&mdash;dated to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] by ''The New Essential Chronology''&mdash;the engagement must have occurred sometime between [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] and 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> before disappearing from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] underworld for the following five [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="Journal10" />

On Stalimur, similarly to other Tion Cluster worlds, a [[The Devouring (holiday)|holiday]] was observed in winter that commemorated [[the Devouring]], the ancient and violent depopulation by the [[Hutt Empire]] of many [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] in the Tion Hegemony's neighboring [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] region. In the Stalimuran version of the holiday, local [[Gender/Legends|males]] [[Fire/Legends|lit]] [[Candle/Legends|candles]] and spent a [[Local day/Legends|night]] in silent confession of the past [[Local year|year's]] sins at specially-constructed shrines on Stalimur's moors.<ref name="Xim" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stalimur was introduced in the form of a mention of the Stalimur pirates in the "[[Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)|Wanted by Cracken]]" segment of the [[May]] [[1996]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|tenth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''. The segment was authored by [[Craig Robert Carey|C. Robert Carey]].<ref name="Journal10" /> The [[December 7]], [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]<ref name="XimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek01/index.html|text=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> article "[[Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster]]" by [[Jason Fry]] first identified Stalimur as a distinct world.<ref name="Xim" /> The [[August 18]], 2009<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Stalimur system, and therefore Stalimur itself, in grid square S-6.<ref name="TEA" />
